description: Implement React web app (Vite + TypeScript) with Firebase Auth, contacts management, and 1-to-1 voice call UI. Mirrors Flutter mobile app screens in responsive web layout. Uses socket.io-client for signaling and browser WebRTC APIs (RTCPeerConnection, getUserMedia). Target: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge latest versions.
steps: Create /apps/web/src/types/: TypeScript interfaces for User, Contact, Call, CallState mirroring Dart models
Create /apps/web/src/services/auth.ts: Firebase Auth wrapper (signup, login, logout, getCurrentUser, getIdToken); exports React hook useAuth() returning auth state and functions

Create /apps/web/src/services/firestore.ts: Firestore CRUD wrappers (same as FEAT-003 Flutter version, but in TypeScript); methods: createUser, getUser, searchUser, listContacts, addContact, respondContact, getCallHistory
Create /apps/web/src/services/socket.ts: Socket.io client connecting to signaling server; event handlers and emit wrappers; exports useSocket() React hook

Create /apps/web/src/services/webrtc.ts: Browser RTCPeerConnection wrapper; methods: createPeerConnection, createOffer, createAnswer, setLocalDescription, addIceCandidate, onLocalStream, onRemoteStream, close; handles getUserMedia({ audio: true })
Create /apps/web/src/context/CallContext.tsx: React Context for call state (current call, call history, call status); provider wrapping entire app
Create /apps/web/src/context/AuthContext.tsx: React Context for authentication state (user, loading, error); provider wrapping entire app
Create /apps/web/src/pages/SplashPage.tsx: Logo, loading spinner, checks auth state, redirects to /login or /contacts
Create /apps/web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Email, password inputs, forgot password link, login button; Firebase Auth login, navigate to /contacts on success
Create /apps/web/src/pages/SignupPage.tsx: Email, password, username inputs; live username availability check; Firebase Auth signup, Firestore user profile creation

Create /apps/web/src/pages/ContactsPage.tsx: Left sidebar with contacts list (accepted only) showing online indicator, search bar, Add Contact button; main area shows selected contact profile or empty state
Create /apps/web/src/pages/AddContactPage.tsx: Search input for username, results list, click to send contact request; confirmation message on success

Create /apps/web/src/pages/CallPage.tsx: Full-screen call UI; variants: Outgoing (callee name, 'Calling...', End button), Incoming (caller name, Accept green / Reject red buttons), In-Call (timer, remote audio visualizer, Mute, Speaker, End buttons)
Create /apps/web/src/components/CallInProgress.tsx: Timer, remote audio element, control buttons (Mute, Speaker, End), connection status indicator
Create /apps/web/src/components/CallHistory.tsx: Paginated list of past calls with status icon, contact name, time, duration; click to call back
Create /apps/web/src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx: Profile section (username, email read-only, logout), notifications preference, blocked users list
Create /apps/web/src/App.tsx: Router setup (React Router v6 with createBrowserRouter), layout with auth guard, error boundary, theme provider (Tailwind/Material-UI)
Create /apps/web/src/main.tsx: Vite entry point; Firebase.initialize(), render App with providers (AuthContext, CallContext)
Create /apps/web/tailwind.config.js and /apps/web/postcss.config.js: Tailwind CSS setup for styling
Create /apps/web/vite.config.ts: Vite config with React plugin, environment variables handling, API proxy for local development (proxy to localhost:3001)
Implement call state machine: listen to Socket.io events, update CallContext (calling, ringing, connected, reconnecting, ended)
Implement WebRTC audio stream handling: getDisplayMedia/getUserMedia, attach to audio element, handle stream end/error
Add connection quality indicator in call UI: subscribe to RTCPeerConnection stats (getStats), display signal strength based on bandwidth and RTT
acceptance_criteria: Signup/login via Firebase Auth works; user profile created in Firestore with uid, username, email, displayName fields
Contacts workflow: search by username, send request, recipient sees pending contact, can accept/decline, only accepted appear in contacts list
Call initiation: click accepted contact, tap Call button, outgoing screen appears with 'Calling...', server receives call:request with correct payload
Incoming call: recipient receives call:incoming event via Socket.io, incoming call page displayed, Accept/Reject buttons functional
WebRTC audio negotiation: offer/answer/ICE exchange completes, audio flows, remote audio plays through browser speaker
In-call controls: Mute toggles microphone, Speaker toggles speaker (if supported by browser), End button closes peer connection and sends call:end
Call history: completed calls logged in Firestore, displayed in call history view paginated, click to call back works
Offline handling: calling offline user shows call unavailable, incoming call shows caller offline if connection drops before answer
Browser compatibility: works on Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge latest versions; WebRTC APIs available and functional
Error handling: invalid token redirects to login, network error shown in UI with retry button, permission denied shows instruction message
verification: Run: cd apps/web && npm install — expect all dependencies installed
Run: cd apps/web && npm run dev — expect Vite dev server starts on localhost:5173
Navigate to http://localhost:5173 in browser, expect Splash/Login page to load
Manual test: sign up with email and unique username via web app, verify Firestore users collection updated, login works
Manual test: search for test contact, send request, switch to other browser tab (other test user), verify pending contact, accept it
Manual test: initiate call from web app to Flutter mobile (or another web tab), verify Outgoing Call screen appears, server logs call:request
Manual test: receive incoming call notification via Socket.io, accept, verify in-call page appears, audio negotiation completes without errors
Manual test: during active call, verify Mute button toggles microphone on/off, Speaker button present (may be read-only on browser), End button closes call
Manual test: check call history in web app, verify completed calls displayed with correct timestamps and durations
Run: cd apps/web && npm run build — expect dist/ directory created with production build artifacts
Browser console: expect no errors or warnings during full signup/login/call/end cycle
